title: Hymns, funeral repertoire, reading versus playing by head
summary: Old bands played hymns and ragtime numbers from memory but read the harder music; Mosley contrasts readers with ear players like George Lewis.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
